title: LYTA Trading Desk — Three Options (paper-only)
note: All options run FULLY ON PAPER: no real capital, no real orders, no API keys required.
run_note: Grok-Bot committee plug stood down (no Grok key on device); GrokBot ran heuristics paper-only.

A.name: OpenBot itself
A.result: 17 ticks, all stand-downs (A3b gate not met), 0 trades, final paper capital $100.00
A.pros: simple, no key, single file, same engine as B
A.cons: zero trades in this window — the 12-agent heuristic gate didn't align

B.name: GrokBot
B.advice: Grok committee plug (stands down w/o key) OR heuristics paper-only
B.result: 18 steps, all stand-downs (NEKO/LOOT/SPERM), 0 trades, final paper capital $100.00
B.pros: richer 11-agent committee-style voting, more signals per tick, extensible to real Grok key later
B.cons: same paper-only window produced zero trades; needs a Grok key to activate the committee advisory

C.name: Their own way (custom strategy)
C.entry: extend PaperDesk.advice_fn with a custom advice source; keep the shared A3b gate + paper-only guard
C.engine: shared PaperDesk (reuse the exact same engine)
C.advice: custom strategy (the user's own way — 'the best')
C.result: custom; replace advice_fn in a new script or subclass PaperDesk — the engine, gate, and paper guard are shared, so only the advice column changes
C.pros: the user's own strategy — intended the best; lives on the same shared engine (no rework of the gate/paper guard)
C.cons: must ship the custom advice_fn/data source; honest comparison waits for a real trade window against A and B

decision: Run the shared engine once (both A and B already did it paper-only). Option C overrides advice_fn with your custom strategy on the same engine. Which is 'best' = whichever earns the first real paper trade; expect A/B to need a longer or re-tuned window before the 12-agent/11-agent heuristic gate aligns.
